title: Mosaic ramshorns
html_source:
Moses was thought among some to have horns thanks to a Biblical mistranslation of the Hebrew Bible into the Latin Vulgate Bible. The Hebrew word taken from Exodus means either a “horn” or an “irradiation.” In early Jewish art Moses is often “shown with rays coming out of his head.”

See, for example, the horns in Michelangelo’s sculpture of Moses:
